The role ensures that the flight software architecture meets mission needs, system-level requirements, and safety and reliability objectives, while remaining scalable, maintainable, and suitable for the evolving needs of our spacecraft platforms. Working closely with Flight Software, Systems Engineering, Avionics, GNC, Mission Operations, and other functional disciplines, the Flight Software Architect drives architectural decisions, technical consistency, and the integration of software across the spacecraft.<\/p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Key Responsibilities<\/strong><\/p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">In your capacity as Flight Software Architect, your role will be continuously evolving, but day to day your duties will include:<\/p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>What we would love to see from you<\/strong><\/p><ol style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Software architecture &amp; design \u2014<\/strong> Define, develop, and maintain the overall flight software architecture, including software components, interfaces, data flows, and execution models, ensuring alignment with spacecraft system architecture and mission objectives.<\/p><\/li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Technical leadership &amp; architectural decisions \u2014<\/strong> Drive key architectural decisions and establish design principles, technical standards, and best practices for flight software development. In pre\u2011sales, you will qualify technical fit, design future\u2011state architectures, run evaluations, and demonstrate how Vercel unlocks measurable business outcomes. You will guide architecture and implementation decisions, identify when to engage Professional Services or Developer Success, and work across Product and Engineering to unblock customers and drive long-term success for critical AI and Web workloads.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;If you\u2019re based within commuting distance of our London or Berlin office, the role includes in-office anchor days.&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;h2&gt;What You Will Do&lt;\/h2&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Partner with Sales to lead technical discovery, qualify customer use cases, and shape solution strategy for key opportunities.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Design target architectures for modern Agentic workflows, and AI and web applications on Vercel, including frontends, APIs, data and edge services, and integrations with headless and composable ecosystems (CMS, commerce, payments, media, analytics).&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Create and deliver tailored demos, technical presentations, and workshops that clearly articulate Vercel\u2019s value and differentiate our platform.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Own and run proofs of concept and pilots end\u2011to\u2011end: define success criteria, guide implementation, remove technical blockers, and ensure executive\u2011level outcomes are documented.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Act as lead architect post\u2011sale for strategic accounts, guiding onboarding, reference implementations, migration patterns, and best practices for building and operating on Vercel.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Proactively engage with customers on performance, reliability, and cost optimization, using metrics like Core Web Vitals, Lighthouse, and observability data to drive continuous improvement.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Collaborate with other members of the Field Engineering Team to standardise playbooks, reusable assets, and patterns that scale across customers and regions.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Respond to and coordinate security, compliance, and architecture reviews, partnering with internal specialists on areas like data protection and regulatory requirements.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Capture recurring themes, patterns, and gaps from the field That means independent journalism is at the heart of all we do as a company. It\u2019s why we have a world-renowned newsroom that sends journalists to report on the ground from nearly 160 countries. It\u2019s why we focus deeply on how our readers will experience our journalism, from print to audio to a world-class digital and app destination. We showcase the expertise of Times journalists on camera, share urgent news updates, produce on-the-ground reporting, and pioneer Visual Investigations.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;The Video department is looking for a Senior Producer to work on the multi-disciplinary Reporter Video team of video journalists who create powerful videos featuring the expertise of our world-class journalists. Based in London, this role will focus on covering breaking news and major international developments in short-form video, producing a mix of quick-turnaround videos, explanatory and analysis pieces, as well as major enterprise and investigations.&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;The Senior Producer will report to a London supervisor and work with the rest of the Reporter Video team in New York and other video hubs, becoming the key manager of the department\u2019s content during the hours that London acts as the main Times hub.&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;We are looking for a strong leader who is eager to motivate, inspire teams and innovate. Attention to detail, impeccable organization and effective communication with reporters and editors in the International Desk are a must.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;You should also be an excellent storyteller with an eye for visual short-form digital formats, able to work autonomously to identify critical stories outside the U.S. and make sound, quick editorial decisions on world news. You will be expected to produce engaging stories through original reporting, on-the-ground filming, motion graphics and studio-based recordings.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;You must have deep experience strengthen relations with colleagues on the International Desk, including mentorship of reporters, photographers and fellow editors on the reporter video storytelling productions.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Support and guide script writing and visual approaches for effective short-form video.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Oversee production across multiple projects.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Guide interviews and shoots as needed, both in studio and field.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Foster experiments with new video approaches and editorial strategies.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Manage video journalists and video editors in the newsroom and field.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Demonstrate support and understanding of our value of journalistic independence and a strong commitment to direct reports.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Demonstrated deep command of a variety of video sources, including wire services, UGC, archival footage, motion graphics, and original footage.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Preferred Requirements:&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Excellent writing, editing and communication skills.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Expert knowledge of current events with advanced-level experience covering breaking news stories in the U.S. and internationally.&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Experience working collaboratively with members of a multidisciplinary With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Tide facts:&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Tide is available for UK, Indian, German and French SMEs&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Over 2 million members globally and rapidly growing&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Over $300 million raised in funding&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;3,000 Tideans globally&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Recognised with Great Place to Work certification three years in a row, and among India\u2019s Top 50 Best Workplaces in Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance in 2026&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;&lt;\/div&gt;&lt;h3&gt;ABOUT THE ROLE:&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/h3&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;At Tide, we&#39;re building the leading financial platform for small businesses. As we continue to grow across multiple markets, strong financial risk management is essential to helping us scale safely, responsibly and sustainably.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;As our &lt;strong&gt;Director of Financial Risk&lt;\/strong&gt;, you&#39;ll lead our global 2LOD Financial Risk team and shape how we identify, assess and oversee financial risks across the business. You&#39;ll own our financial risk framework while providing independent oversight, challenge and trusted advice to 1LOD teams across:&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Financial Reporting &amp;amp; Control (statutory &amp;amp; regulatory accounting),&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;FP&amp;amp;A (management accounting &amp;amp; commercial finance),&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Finance Operations (including account operations, reconciliations, AP &amp;amp; AR, payroll)&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Treasury&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Finance Product (systems support for Finance).&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Corporate Development (for any CorDev working impacting FinRisk)&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;As well as the Regional Heads\/Directors of Finance that coordinate these functions for their region (UK, EU, India).&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;This is a highly visible leadership role, and you\u2019ll be at the forefront of scaling in new markets, working on new licences, and new products. We are looking for not just a deep subject matter expert, but a trusted leader to help us scale whilst managing our financial risks.&amp;nbsp; You will need to be a strong collaborator, as you&#39;ll work closely with a variety of stakeholders, from senior leadership and executives to auditors and banking partners, to ensure Tide remains financially resilient while continuing to innovate for our members.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;h3&gt;WHAT YOU&#39;LL BE DOING&lt;\/h3&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;This is a global role in which you will:&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Own and evolve Tide&#39;s Financial Risk Management Framework, ensuring it grows with the business as we expand into new markets, launch new products and operate under new licences.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Provide independent oversight and challenge of 1LOD activities relating to financial risks, working mostly with Finance and Treasury. You need to be deeply familiar with how a global Treasury function works, to be able to identify and manage risks arising.&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Ensure alignment of financial risk governance across all regulated entities and jurisdictions.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Maintain and enhance financial risk appetite metrics, limits, triggers, and escalation protocols.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Deliver clear and independent reporting to Group and entity-level Risk &amp;amp; Compliance Committees and Boards.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Monitor capital adequacy, liquidity, concentration risks, and financial resilience.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Support regulatory engagements, audits, thematic reviews, and licence applications.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Independently oversee treasury and liquidity management activities.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Review and challenge liquidity forecasting methodologies and stress assumptions.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Maintain existing risk policies and frameworks, and develop new ones as required.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Lead financial risk assessments for new products, partnerships, and market launches.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Partner with other Risk &amp;amp; Compliance teams, various Finance teams, Legal and Internal Audit teams to ensure integrated risk management.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Present concise and insightful risk reporting to Risk &amp;amp; Compliance Committees, and lead on the Financial Risk Working Groups&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Lead a high-performing and experienced global financial risk team.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;h3&gt;WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR:&lt;\/h3&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;We&#39;re looking for someone who combines deep technical expertise with excellent judgement and the ability to influence across the organisation.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;You&#39;ll likely have:&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Significant experience leading Financial Risk within fintech, payments, e-money, banking or another regulated financial services environment.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Experience operating in a 2LOD leadership role.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Strong knowledge of financial risk frameworks within payment institutions, e-money institutions or digital banking.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Deep expertise across treasury, liquidity, solvability, capital, solvency, statutory reporting and tax risk.&amp;nbsp;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Accounting expertise; ideally with an accounting qualification.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Experience working across multiple regulatory jurisdictions and engaging directly with regulators and auditors.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;The ability to balance strong risk management with commercial ambition in a fast-moving business.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Excellent communication skills, with the confidence to influence senior stakeholders and provide independent challenge when it matters.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;A collaborative leadership style, with experience building and developing high-performing teams.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Most importantly, you&#39;ll enjoy working in a fast-paced environment, be comfortable navigating change, and care about helping Tide build a resilient business that continues to deliver for our members.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;h3&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/h3&gt;\n&lt;h3&gt;WHAT YOU\u2019LL GET IN RETURN:&lt;\/h3&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Competitive Compensation -&amp;nbsp; competitive salary and share options&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Time Off \u2013 Generous annual leave on top of bank holidays.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Parental Leave \u2013 Paid maternity, paternity, and adoption leave to support your family journey&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Sabbatical \u2013 Extended unpaid and paid leave options after completing milestone years with Tide&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Access to salary sacrifice benefits \u2013 like Nursery (could save up to 47% on fees!) and Cycle to Work discounts&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Health Insurance \u2013 Comprehensive Private family insurance plan&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Life &amp;amp; Accident Cover \u2013 Comprehensive accidental and life insurance protection&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Mental Wellbeing \u2013 Access to therapy sessions, courses, meditations, and workshops&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Retirement Planning \u2013 Build your retirement fund faster with Tide\u2019s pension scheme on eligible earnings&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Volunteering &amp;amp; Development Days \u2013 Paid days annually for volunteering or personal growth&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Learning &amp;amp; Development \u2013 Annual budget for books, courses, coaching, and more&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;WOO (Work Outside the Office) \u2013 Work from abroad for up to 90 days annually&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Home Office Setup \u2013 Contribution towards setting up your home office&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Laptop Ownership \u2013 Keep your old laptop and get a new one when it\u2019s time for a replacement&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Snacks &amp;amp; Meals \u2013 Daily breakfast spread with all-day coffee, tea, and juices&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;h3&gt;TIDEAN WAYS OF WORKING&lt;\/h3&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;At Tide, we champion a &lt;strong&gt;flexible workplace &lt;\/strong&gt;model that&lt;strong&gt; &lt;\/strong&gt;supports both in-person and remote work to cater to the specific needs of our different teams.&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;While remote work is supported, we believe in the power of face-to-face interactions to foster team spirit and collaboration. Our offices are designed as hubs for innovation and team-building, where we encourage regular in-person gatherings to foster a strong sense of community.&lt;\/p&gt;&lt;div class=&quot;content-conclusion&quot;&gt;&lt;h3&gt;TIDE IS A PLACE FOR EVERYONE&lt;\/h3&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;At Tide, we believe that we can only succeed if we let our differences enrich our culture. Our Tideans come from a variety of backgrounds and experience levels. We consider everyone irrespective of their ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, veteran, neurodiversity or differently-abled status. We celebrate diversity in our workforce as a cornerstone of our success. Our commitment to a broad spectrum of ideas and backgrounds is what enables us to build products that resonate with our members\u2019 diverse needs and lives.&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;We are One Team and foster a transparent and inclusive environment, where everyone\u2019s voice is heard.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;em&gt;At Tide, we thrive on diversity, embracing various backgrounds and experiences. We welcome all individuals regardless of ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, or disability. Our inclusive culture is key to our success, helping us build products that meet our members&#39; diverse needs. This role is based in our London office with a &lt;strong&gt;hybrid&lt;\/strong&gt; setup, typically 3 days in the office.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Get to know our &lt;a class=&quot;ng-star-inserted&quot; href=&quot;https:\/\/careers.deliveroo.co.uk\/software-engineering-at-deliveroo\/&quot; target=&quot;_blank&quot;&gt;Engineering&lt;\/a&gt; team \u2014 what drives us, how we work, and what you can expect.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;div style=&quot;min-height: 1.2em; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0;&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/div&gt;\n&lt;h2&gt;&lt;strong&gt;About the Team&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/h2&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;The Core BI team builds and operates the services, integrations and automation that power business intelligence across DoorDash, Deliveroo and Wolt. Our platforms help analysts, Analytics Engineers, Data Scientists, Software Engineers and business teams discover trusted data and make informed decisions at scale.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;We combine software engineering, platform ownership, and a strong user focus to make BI tooling reliable, secure, scalable and self-service. The team supports the current BI ecosystem while helping shape a more integrated experience across the DoorDash group.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;h2&gt;&lt;strong&gt;About the Role&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/h2&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;As a BI Engineer on the Core BI team, you will build and operate the models, systems and automation behind our BI platforms. This will include supporting our extensive user base on our current BI stack (primarily Looker and Sigma) while helping shape a single, more integrated BI platform across DoorDash, Deliveroo and Wolt.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;You will own problems from discovery through design, implementation, deployment, and operational support. You will work closely with Data Engineers, Analytics Engineers, Data Scientists, Software Engineers, Product Managers and business teams to turn recurring user needs into durable, self-service capabilities. If you&#39;re energized by solving technical problems with data and comfortable being deeply embedded across several domains, this role is for you!&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;You\u2019re excited about this opportunity because you will\u2026&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Own and evolve the semantic layer behind our BI platforms: LookML and Canvas BI models, metric and dimension definitions, and the governance that keeps them trusted&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Build and operate the Looker and Sigma platforms themselves: instance and workspace configuration, permissions and user attributes, content lifecycle, and API-driven automation&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Lead the development of self-serve tooling that removes manual BI administration, using usage analytics to decide what to automate, build or retire next&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Support BI platform migrations and deprecations across DoorDash, Deliveroo and Wolt while protecting access, governance, data integrity and business continuity&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Take part in operational support, production debugging and incident response for the BI stack, and fix the root causes you find&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Champion engineering standards in BI, including version control, code review, CI and testing for models and platform code, so changes ship safely and repeatably&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;h2&gt;&lt;strong&gt;We\u2019re excited about you because\u2026&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/h2&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;3+ years of experience in business intelligence engineering, analytics engineering, data engineering, or a similar code-first data role&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Strong Python and SQL skills, and hands-on experience using AI tools (LLMs, agentic workflows, AI-assisted development) to accelerate your own engineering work&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Hands-on experience building in a BI platform such as Looker (LookML) or Sigma, modelling and configuring it, not only building dashboards in it&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Experience with semantic or metrics layers (LookML, dbt or similar): defining metrics and dimensions, and keeping those definitions consistent as they are reused&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Experience running what you build in production: version control, code review, CI, debugging live issues and taking part in operational support&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Excellent communication skills, and comfortable self-organising in a fast-paced, distributed environment with both technical and non-technical teams&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;h2&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Nice to Have&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/h2&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Experience with modern data warehousing platforms (e.g., Snowflake, Databricks, Redshift) and ability to optimize performance&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Experience automating BI administration through platform APIs, or identity and access through Okta, SCIM or role-based access controls&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Experience supporting a BI stack across multiple brands, tenants or regions, or leading a BI platform migration&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;h2&gt;Why Join Us?&lt;\/h2&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;At Deliveroo, you\u2019ll do work that matters\u2014solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that\u2019s constantly evolving. We\u2019re food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to:&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;\ud83d\udd27 &lt;strong&gt;Solve meaningful problems at real scale&lt;\/strong&gt; Work on a complex, always-on marketplace that impacts millions every day.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;\ud83c\udf31 &lt;strong&gt;See your impact, fast&lt;\/strong&gt; Ship, test and improve ideas quickly in a low-hierarchy, high-ownership environment.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;\ud83e\udde0 &lt;strong&gt;Grow through challenge and ownership&lt;\/strong&gt; Take on big, ambiguous problems and accelerate your career with strong support.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;\ud83c\udf0e &lt;strong&gt;A culture built for builders&lt;\/strong&gt; High standards, collaboration, flexible working and continuous learning.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;\u27a1\ufe0f Want a deeper look at how we build? Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. We believe that creating an environment where everyone feels a sense of belonging is central to our culture and that diversity is paramount to driving creativity, innovation, and value for our clients and for our people.&lt;\/span&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;h3&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;color: rgb(0, 53, 142);&quot; data-contrast=&quot;none&quot;&gt;An award-winning workplace&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/h3&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;span data-contrast=&quot;none&quot;&gt;You can be a part of our \u2018Great Place to Work\u2019 \u2013 with our commitment to women and well-being in the workplace for all.\u202f&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;a href=&quot;https:\/\/www.baringa.com\/en\/impact\/awards\/&quot;&gt;&lt;span data-contrast=&quot;none&quot;&gt;Click here&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/a&gt;&lt;span data-contrast=&quot;none&quot;&gt;\u202fto see some of our recent awards and how we\u2019ve achieved this.&lt;\/span&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;h3&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;color: rgb(0, 53, 142);&quot;&gt;&lt;span data-contrast=&quot;none&quot;&gt;Using business as a force for good.&lt;\/span&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/h3&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;span data-contrast=&quot;none&quot;&gt;We maintain high standards of environmental performance and transparency, which can be seen through our commitment to Net Zero with our SBTI-verified Scope 1, 2 and 3 emissions reduction targets and our support of the Better Business Act. We report our progress publicly and ensure that we are also externally assessed and scored through organisations like CDP and EcoVadis - helping us to continually identify where we can improve.&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;span data-ccp-props=&quot;{&amp;quot;201341983&amp;quot;:0,&amp;quot;335559738&amp;quot;:200,&amp;quot;335559739&amp;quot;:0,&amp;quot;335559740&amp;quot;:240}&quot;&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;span data-contrast=&quot;none&quot;&gt;We have a long legacy of supporting the communities in which we work, and offer a variety of ways to contribute, by putting people first and creating impact that lasts. Our Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) agenda is about giving back to the communities in which we live and work by sharing our skills, talent and time. In essence, we aim to empower and encourage everyone in the firm to contribute to the things we care about, and support registered charities and organisations with a clear social or environmental purpose to increase the positive impact they can have.&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;&lt;div class=&quot;content-conclusion&quot;&gt;&lt;h3&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;color: rgb(208, 0, 111); font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;&quot; data-teams=&quot;true&quot;&gt;Join us&lt;\/span&gt;&lt;\/h3&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;span style=&quot;font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;&quot; data-teams=&quot;true&quot;&gt;All applications received will be reviewed by a member of our Talent Acquisition team. We never rely solely on automated screening or AI tools to make hiring decisions. Your application will be considered for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, nationality, disability, age, faith or social background. We do not filter applications by university background and encourage those who have taken alternative educational and career paths to apply. We would like to actively encourage applications from those who identify with less represented and minority groups. These are established, often global and regulated enterprises, where buying decisions take time, many business units are involved, and incident management is part of a wider move away from legacy tools and processes. From there you\u2019ll expand across the enterprise, mapping the organisation, finding champions and repeating proven wins across business units and regions. You\u2019ll run Executive Business Reviews and connect our leadership with theirs, tying what we do to what matters to their business: operational resilience, regulatory risk, the cost of downtime, tool consolidation, MTTR reduction and incident process maturity.<\/p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">You\u2019ll lead onboarding and migrations in organisations that move carefully, moving them off legacy tools and ITSM-led processes and making the change stick, including deeper adoption across Response, On-call, Status Pages and our AI capabilities. They interface daily with a motivated team of program leadership, functional leadership, and customers in fast-paced environments. &lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;h3&gt;ABOUT THE JOB&lt;\/h3&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Anduril is seeking a talented Contracts Manager to support a variety of Government, International, and Commercial contracts and programs. In this role, you will oversee the full contract lifecycle for Anduril&#39;s government and commercial contracts, ensuring compliance, minimizing risk, and optimizing contract performance. The ideal candidate will combine deep knowledge of commercial and defence contracting with strong negotiation skills and a passion for supporting national security through technological innovation. &lt;br&gt;&lt;br&gt;The position will be responsible for providing contract support for various Government contracts and commercial contracts. Support of these contracts will involve proposal support, contract negotiation, contract compliance, contract management, contract modifications, and contract close-out. This role works closely with the legal and proposal teams as well as across the spectrum of Anduril\u2019s accounting, business operations, program, and engineering teams.&lt;br&gt;&lt;br&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;h4&gt;WHAT YOU WILL DO&lt;\/h4&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Execute contract management throughout the life of each contract.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Complete contract review and acceptance.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Oversee and prepare contract proposal planning and management and support preparation of proposals.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Ensure compliance with government regulations, legal requirements, and company policies.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Assist in identification, development, and implementation of new contract policies and processes.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Maintain comprehensive contract documentation and compliance records.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Provide contract summaries and ensure contract execution in accordance with government and company requirements.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Provide program managers and executives with contract briefs during the life of contracts.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Provide guidance on ASDEFCON requirements and other regulatory considerations.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Cultivate strong, ongoing relationships with internal\/external customers.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Provide contractual guidance and risk mitigation strategies for contractual and business obligations.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Negotiate complex contractual terms with government agencies, prime contractors, and subcontractors.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;h4&gt;REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS&lt;\/h4&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;6+ years of relevant contract management contracting including ASDEFCON, Commonwealth Procurement Rules (CPRs), and\/or Defence Security Principles Framework (DSPF) experience.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Experience with full life cycle contract management for various types of contract agreements&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Excellent verbal and written communication skills&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Exceptional analytical and problem-solving abilities. Proc\u00e9d\u00e9s pour l\u2019Energie, l\u2019Environnement et la Sant\u00e9) dont l\u2019objectif est de renseigner l\u2019influence des pluies sur les d\u00e9p\u00f4ts de pesticides au niveau national, en plus des donn\u00e9es existantes dans l\u2019air ambiant.<\/p><p class=\"MsoNormal\" style=\"text-align:justify;\"><strong>L\u2019IMT Nord Europe<\/strong> est une \u00e9cole sous tutelle du minist\u00e8re de l\u2019\u00e9conomie, des finances et de la souverainet\u00e9 industrielle et num\u00e9rique. IMT Nord Europe est n\u00e9e en 2017 de la fusion de T\u00e9l\u00e9com Lille et de l\u2019\u00c9cole des Mines de Douai. Elle compte aujourd\u2019hui parmi les plus Grandes \u00c9coles d\u2019ing\u00e9nieurs au Nord de Paris avec plus 2200 \u00e9l\u00e8ves, dont un quart d\u2019apprentis, plus de 600 dipl\u00f4m\u00e9s par an et un r\u00e9seau de 15 000 dipl\u00f4m\u00e9s. Elle fait partie de l\u2019Institut Mines T\u00e9l\u00e9com, premier groupe public de Grandes \u00c9coles d\u2019ing\u00e9nieurs et de management de France, et est partenaire de l\u2019universit\u00e9 de Lille.<\/p><p class=\"MsoNormal\" style=\"text-align:justify;\">IMT Nord Europe a 3 missions principales : former des ing\u00e9nieurs responsables aptes \u00e0 r\u00e9soudre les grandes probl\u00e9matiques du XXI\u00e8me si\u00e8cle ; mener des recherches d\u00e9bouchant sur des innovations \u00e0 haute valeur ajout\u00e9e ; soutenir le d\u00e9veloppement des territoires notamment en facilitant l\u2019innovation et les cr\u00e9ations d\u2019entreprises. Son objectif est de former les ing\u00e9nieurs de demain, ma\u00eetrisant \u00e0 la fois les technologies num\u00e9riques et les savoir-faire industriels. Id\u00e9alement situ\u00e9e au carrefour de l\u2019Europe, \u00e0 1 heure de Paris, 30 minutes de Bruxelles et 1H30 de Londres, IMT Nord Europe a l\u2019ambition de devenir un acteur majeur des grandes transformations industrielles, num\u00e9riques et environnementales du XXI\u00e8me si\u00e8cle en combinant, tant dans ses enseignements et que dans sa recherche, les sciences de l\u2019ing\u00e9nieur et les technologies du digital.<\/p><p class=\"MsoNormal\" style=\"text-align:justify;\">Localis\u00e9e sur 2 sites principaux d\u2019enseignement et de recherche, \u00e0 Lille et \u00e0 Douai, IMT Nord Europe s\u2019appuie sur plus de 20 000 m\u00b2 de laboratoire pour d\u00e9velopper un enseignement de haut niveau et une recherche d\u2019excellence dans les trois domaines \u00ab&nbsp;Syst\u00e8mes Num\u00e9riques&nbsp;\u00bb, \u00ab&nbsp;Energie Environnement&nbsp;\u00bb et \u00ab&nbsp;Mat\u00e9riaux et Proc\u00e9d\u00e9s&nbsp;\u00bb.<\/p><p class=\"MsoNormal\" style=\"text-align:justify;\">Le CERI EE d\u2019IMT Nord Europe d\u00e9veloppe des activit\u00e9s au c\u0153ur des transitions \u00e9nerg\u00e9tiques et environnementales. Sa recherche est orient\u00e9e vers les sciences de l'atmosph\u00e8re, la qualit\u00e9 des environnements int\u00e9rieurs et les enjeux de l\u2019efficacit\u00e9 \u00e9nerg\u00e9tique et de la d\u00e9carbonation. La candidate\/le candidat int\u00e9grera l\u2019un des 3 axes th\u00e9matiques du CERI EE, l\u2019axe OSPA (Observations, Sources et Processus physico-chimiques Atmosph\u00e9riques).<\/p><p class=\"MsoNormal\" style=\"text-align:justify;\">Pour plus de d\u00e9tails, consulter le site internet de l\u2019\u00c9cole : <u><a rel=\"noopener\" target=\"_blank\" href=\"http:\/\/www.imt-lille-douai.fr\/\">www.imt-nord-europe.fr<\/a><\/u> et celui du CERI EE <u><a rel=\"noopener\" target=\"_blank\" href=\"https:\/\/recherche.imt-nord-europe.fr\/energie-environnement-ceri\">https:\/\/recherche.imt-nord-europe.fr\/energie-environnement-ceri<\/a><\/u><\/p><p class=\"MsoNormal\" style=\"text-align:justify;\"><strong>L\u2019ICPEES (Institut de Chimie et Proc\u00e9d\u00e9s pour l'Energie, l'Environnement et la Sant\u00e9, UMR 7515 du CNRS et de l\u2019Universit\u00e9 de Strasbourg)<\/strong> a \u00e9t\u00e9 cr\u00e9\u00e9 en janvier 2013 lorsque deux laboratoires, le Laboratoire des mat\u00e9riaux, surfaces et proc\u00e9d\u00e9s pour la catalyse (LMSPC) et le Laboratoire d'ing\u00e9nierie des polym\u00e8res pour les hautes technologies (LIPHT), d\u00e9cident de fusionner. Lors de la fusion, les trois \u00e9quipes du LIPHT et les sept \u00e9quipes du LMSPC ont \u00e9t\u00e9 structur\u00e9es en trois d\u00e9partements de recherche : catalyse et mat\u00e9riaux, chimie mol\u00e9culaire et analytique, ing\u00e9nierie des polym\u00e8res.<\/p><p class=\"MsoNormal\" style=\"text-align:justify;\">La transversalit\u00e9 des comp\u00e9tences pr\u00e9sentes au sein de l\u2019Institut permet de traiter des probl\u00e9matiques globales allant de la synth\u00e8se des mol\u00e9cules \u00e0 l\u2019\u00e9laboration de l\u2019objet final pour des applications li\u00e9es \u00e0 l'Energie, l'Environnement ou la Sant\u00e9. L\u2019implication forte des \u00e9quipes de l\u2019unit\u00e9 dans les recherches fondamentales avec une vis\u00e9e applicative a permis au laboratoire de se positionner sur l\u2019ensemble de la cha\u00eene de valeur et d\u2019acqu\u00e9rir une renomm\u00e9e internationale. Les collaborations acad\u00e9miques tant nationales qu\u2019internationales ont contribu\u00e9 aussi aux d\u00e9veloppements de nouveaux axes de recherche inexploit\u00e9s \u00e0 l\u2019heure actuelle. Les d\u00e9veloppements avals des recherches men\u00e9es au sein de l\u2019unit\u00e9 ont \u00e9galement permis de tisser de nombreuses collaborations avec le monde socio-\u00e9conomique en apportant des solutions concr\u00e8tes aux diff\u00e9rentes demandes soci\u00e9tales et en d\u00e9veloppant de nouveaux proc\u00e9d\u00e9s en ad\u00e9quation avec les nouvelles l\u00e9gislations.&nbsp;<\/p><p class=\"MsoNormal\" style=\"text-align:justify;\">Les activit\u00e9s de recherche au sein de l\u2019unit\u00e9 ne peuvent \u00eatre men\u00e9es d\u2019une mani\u00e8re sereine, sans l\u2019appui fort des p\u00f4les de soutien \u00e0 la recherche, qui ont permis de fluidifier les demandes techniques et administratives. L\u2019excellente coh\u00e9sion entre ces p\u00f4les et les \u00e9quipes de recherche a contribu\u00e9 \u00e9galement \u00e0 mieux anticiper des probl\u00e8mes \u00e9ventuels et \u00e0 d\u2019optimiser le fonctionnement quotidien au sein de l\u2019unit\u00e9. En 2020, la direction de l\u2019ICPEES a organis\u00e9 le service commun technique en 3 p\u00f4les : le P\u00f4le Caract\u00e9risation, le P\u00f4le Ing\u00e9nierie et D\u00e9veloppement et le P\u00f4le Chimie.<\/p><p class=\"MsoNormal\" style=\"text-align:justify;\">Pour plus de d\u00e9tails, consulter le site internet de l\u2019ICPEES :<\/p><p class=\"MsoNormal\" style=\"text-align:justify;\"><u><a rel=\"noopener\" target=\"_blank\" href=\"https:\/\/icpees.unistra.fr\">https:\/\/icpees.unistra.fr<\/a><\/u><\/p><p class=\"MsoNormal\"><strong><u>Missions<\/u>&nbsp;:<\/strong><\/p><p class=\"MsoNormal\" style=\"text-align:justify;\">Le doctorant aura pour mission d\u2019\u00e9valuer la dynamique des d\u00e9p\u00f4ts atmosph\u00e9riques de pesticides \u00e0 diff\u00e9rentes \u00e9chelles spatiales et temporelles en collaboration avec l\u2019observatoire MERA (<u><a rel=\"noopener\" target=\"_blank\" href=\"https:\/\/www.lcsqa.org\/fr\/le-dispositif-mera\">https:\/\/www.lcsqa.org\/fr\/le-dispositif-mera<\/a><\/u>) et les AASQA (<u><a rel=\"noopener\" target=\"_blank\" href=\"https:\/\/www.atmo-france.org\/\">https:\/\/www.atmo-france.org\/<\/a><\/u>) sur le territoire national. Dans un premier temps, il devra adapter les m\u00e9thodes d\u2019analyse de pesticides existantes en GC\/MSMS et LC\/MSMS dans l\u2019\u00e9quipe \u00ab&nbsp;CAMATES (<strong>C<\/strong>himie <strong>A<\/strong>nalytique <strong>MAT<\/strong>\u00e9riaux, <strong>E<\/strong>nvironnement <strong>S<\/strong>ant\u00e9)&nbsp;\u00bb de l\u2019ICPEES (UMR 7515 CNRS-UNISTRA), en particulier int\u00e9grer les pesticides de la liste prioritaire de l\u2019ANSES<u><a rel=\"noopener\" target=\"_blank\" href=\"#_ftn1\">[1]<\/a><\/u> et ceux du dispositif Pesticides coordonn\u00e9 par le LCSQA<u><a rel=\"noopener\" target=\"_blank\" href=\"#_ftn2\">[2]<\/a><\/u> (<u><a rel=\"noopener\" target=\"_blank\" href=\"https:\/\/www.lcsqa.org\/fr\/le-dispositif-pesticides\">https:\/\/www.lcsqa.org\/fr\/le-dispositif-pesticides<\/a><\/u>). Il aura \u00e9galement pour mission de d\u00e9terminer la m\u00e9thode technique d\u2019extraction de ces mol\u00e9cules et de quantifier l\u2019effet de matrice\/interf\u00e9rences potentiels que peuvent g\u00e9n\u00e9rer les eaux pluviales et les d\u00e9p\u00f4ts secs. Pour cela, il disposera d\u2019\u00e9chantillons r\u00e9els de d\u00e9p\u00f4ts totaux (humides et secs) qu\u2019il dopera avec des mol\u00e9cules non pr\u00e9sentes dans les \u00e9chantillons et des \u00e9talons marqu\u00e9s.<\/p><p class=\"MsoNormal\" style=\"text-align:justify;\">Il aura ensuite la t\u00e2che d\u2019analyser les \u00e9chantillons de d\u00e9p\u00f4ts atmosph\u00e9riques collect\u00e9s de mani\u00e8re hebdomadaire pendant 1 an sur plusieurs sites d\u2019\u00e9tude et \u00e9galement de quantifier si la r\u00e9frig\u00e9ration des \u00e9chantillons pendant leur stockage dans le pr\u00e9leveur est indispensable.<\/p><p class=\"MsoNormal\" style=\"text-align:justify;\">Enfin, il aura \u00e0 interpr\u00e9ter et analyser les r\u00e9sultats en termes d\u2019occurrence, de variabilit\u00e9 spatiale et temporelle (influence de l\u2019activit\u00e9 agricole), de relation avec les conditions m\u00e9t\u00e9orologiques (trajectoire des masses d\u2019air) et de corr\u00e9lation avec d\u2019autres polluants atmosph\u00e9riques ou des mesures de pesticides dans l\u2019air ambiant r\u00e9alis\u00e9es en parall\u00e8le par les AASQA.<\/p><p They should enjoy working autonomously in an environment where there is still a lot to build.<\/p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>You may be a great fit at Alan if you have\/are:<\/strong><\/p><ul style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">5+ years of experience in partnerships, business development, account management or customer success in a B2B environment<\/p><\/li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Experience managing partnerships throughout the full lifecycle, from prospecting and closing to activation and ongoing relationship management<\/p><\/li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Experience managing a portfolio of partners, ideally in a fast-growing company<\/p><\/li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Strong negotiation, communication, presentation and relationship-building skills<\/p><\/li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">A data-oriented mindset, with the ability to track performance and prioritise opportunities<\/p><\/li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">The ability to collaborate effectively with Sales, Marketing, Product, Data and Operations teams<\/p><\/li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">An entrepreneurial mindset, strong ownership and the ability to work autonomously<\/p><\/li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Full professional fluency in French and professional fluency in English<\/p><\/li><\/ul><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Experience working directly with accounting firms, payroll providers, HR software or insurance companies would be a strong plus.<\/p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">We are particularly interested in candidates who have experience with B2B distribution partnerships, where a third party recommends or distributes a solution to its own customers. Il s&#39;agit d&#39;une couche d&#39;intelligence centralis\u00e9e et agnostique des outils, capable d&#39;interagir avec l&#39;ensemble de notre infrastructure (Workday, Data Lake, University, ...) pour faire \u00e9voluer nos interfaces d&#39;une logique de consultation vers une logique d&#39;action.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Dans ce cadre, nous d\u00e9veloppons &lt;strong&gt;DaiLY&lt;\/strong&gt;, notre agent conversationnel RH. Il aide nos collaborateurs et managers \u00e0 acc\u00e9der instantan\u00e9ment \u00e0 une information fiable, sourc\u00e9e \u00e0 partir de notre documentation Workday et de nos politiques People.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;D\u00e9j\u00e0 d\u00e9ploy\u00e9 avec succ\u00e8s en France, DaiLY entre dans une nouvelle phase de passage \u00e0 l&#39;\u00e9chelle : extension internationale, industrialisation des \u00e9valuations, am\u00e9lioration continue de nos mod\u00e8les et de leurs qualit\u00e9s et d\u00e9ploiement et int\u00e9gration d\u2019agents autonomes RH.&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Pour mener ce projet, nous ne recherchons pas uniquement un.e d\u00e9veloppeur.se, nous avons besoin d&#39;un.e &quot;&lt;strong&gt;Builder&lt;\/strong&gt;&quot; : un.e personne capable de traduire un besoin m\u00e9tier en solution technique, de l\u2019impl\u00e9menter, la qualifier, la d\u00e9ployer et la maintenir dans le temps.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;h3&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/h3&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&amp;nbsp;\ud83c\udfaf VOTRE MISSION&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Nous recherchons un(e) &lt;strong&gt;AI Engineer confirm\u00e9(e)&lt;\/strong&gt; pour participer activement \u00e0 l&#39;industrialisation et au d\u00e9veloppement de DaiLY. Votre objectif est clair : transformer les besoins m\u00e9tiers RH en fonctionnalit\u00e9s IA fiables, mesurables et robustes.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Pour relever ce d\u00e9fi, vous \u00e9voluerez au &lt;strong&gt;sein d&#39;un collectif d\u00e9di\u00e9&lt;\/strong&gt;, en collaboration directe avec d&#39;autres AI Engineers, un Lead AI Engineer (qui orientera les choix d&#39;architecture globale) et une Product Manager. Cette organisation de proximit\u00e9 vous permettra d&#39;assurer une synergie parfaite entre les enjeux produits, la roadmap et l&#39;impl\u00e9mentation technique.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Vous aurez notamment un r\u00f4le cl\u00e9 dans l&#39;\u00e9volution de DaiLY : passer d&#39;un mod\u00e8le de simple consultation (Q&amp;amp;A) \u00e0 un &lt;strong&gt;v\u00e9ritable syst\u00e8me agentique transactionnel&lt;\/strong&gt; capable de d\u00e9clencher des actions concr\u00e8tes (ex : poser des cong\u00e9s dans Workday, s&#39;inscrire \u00e0 des formations via Decathlon University).&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;h3&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/h3&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;\ud83d\udee0 VOS RESPONSABILITES&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ol&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;D\u00e9veloppement Agentique &amp;amp; Fonctionnalit\u00e9s&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ol&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Participer \u00e0 l&#39;extension des capacit\u00e9s de DaiLY vers des actions d&#39;\u00e9criture (write actions) en impl\u00e9mentant des protocoles de tool-calling (MCP - Model Context Protocol) et des communications inter-agents (A2A).&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Impl\u00e9menter des strat\u00e9gies avanc\u00e9es de chunking et de re-ranking pour prioriser les r\u00e8gles sp\u00e9cifiques au domaine RH.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Contribuer \u00e0 l&#39;optimisation des co\u00fbts, de la latence et de l&#39;efficacit\u00e9 globale du syst\u00e8me en lien avec les \u00e9quipes Plateforme et Infrastructure.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;ol&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Qualit\u00e9, \u00c9valuation &amp;amp; Observabilit\u00e9 (LLMOps)&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ol&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;D\u00e9velopper et maintenir la couche de qualit\u00e9 du pipeline RAG multi-agents (Vertex AI Search \/ Discovery Engine).&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Assurer le grounding (ancrage) des r\u00e9ponses et la v\u00e9rification des citations pour garantir la tra\u00e7abilit\u00e9 vers une source de v\u00e9rit\u00e9.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Mettre en place des pipelines d&#39;observabilit\u00e9 robustes pour l&#39;\u00e9valuation online et offline (OpenTelemetry, MLflow).&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Coder des \u00e9valuateurs automatiques bas\u00e9s sur des golden datasets pour it\u00e9rer sereinement et pr\u00e9venir les r\u00e9gressions avant chaque mise en production.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Int\u00e9grer des garde-fous (guardrails) pour prot\u00e9ger le syst\u00e8me et les utilisateurs contre les hallucinations et les erreurs.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;ol&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;S\u00e9curit\u00e9, Cloisonnement &amp;amp; D\u00e9ploiement International&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ol&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Access Management (ACLs) : Impl\u00e9menter une gestion granulaire et dynamique des droits d&#39;acc\u00e8s au niveau de l&#39;indexation et du retrieval, garantissant qu&#39;un collaborateur n&#39;acc\u00e8de strictement qu&#39;aux documents RH de son p\u00e9rim\u00e8tre.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Isolation &amp;amp; Multi-tenancy : Mettre en \u0153uvre des strat\u00e9gies de filtrage par m\u00e9tadonn\u00e9es (metadata filtering) en base vectorielle et de cloisonnement (des index et\/ou des mod\u00e8les) pour assurer une \u00e9tanch\u00e9it\u00e9 parfaite des donn\u00e9es entre les diff\u00e9rentes soci\u00e9t\u00e9s fiscales, entit\u00e9s l\u00e9gales et g\u00e9ographies de Decathlon.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Support Multilingue : Contribuer \u00e0 l&#39;architecture d&#39;internationalisation de DaiLY en adaptant les pipelines RAG, l&#39;embedding et l&#39;inf\u00e9rence pour maintenir un haut niveau de performance et de pertinence sur une grande diversit\u00e9 de langues.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;ol&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Produit &amp;amp; Impact Business&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ol&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Aider \u00e0 l&#39;analyse des intentions des utilisateurs pour mesurer l&#39;impact de DaiLY.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Traduire, avec l&#39;appui de la Product Manager et du Lead, les enjeux m\u00e9tier en comportements de mod\u00e8les et en m\u00e9triques de succ\u00e8s.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;\ud83e\udde0 PROFIL RECHERCHE&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Nous recherchons un profil justifiant a minima d\u2019une premi\u00e8re exp\u00e9rience.&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Exp\u00e9rience :&lt;\/strong&gt; Profil confirm\u00e9 justifiant de&lt;strong&gt; trois ann\u00e9es d&#39;exp\u00e9rience professionnelle&lt;\/strong&gt; en entreprise (hors stages et alternances) en AI Engineering, ML Engineering ou Software Engineering orient\u00e9 IA. Vous justifiez \u00e9galement d&#39;au moins une exp\u00e9rience concr\u00e8te et r\u00e9ussie de mise en production d&#39;un syst\u00e8me GenAI ou agentique.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Stack Technique&lt;\/strong&gt; : Solide ma\u00eetrise de Python, de l&#39;\u00e9cosyst\u00e8me GCP \/ Vertex AI, et des frameworks d&#39;orchestration (LangChain, LlamaIndex ou ADK).&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Expertise LLM &amp;amp; Agentique &lt;\/strong&gt;: Solide ma\u00eetrise des architectures RAG (recherche vectorielle, Vertex AI Vector Search, gestion avanc\u00e9e de m\u00e9tadonn\u00e9es), mais surtout des concepts techniques agentiques : function\/tool-calling, boucles de raisonnement (ReAct, etc.), orchestration de workflows multi-agents, structured output et gestion du contexte\/m\u00e9moire.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Qualit\u00e9 &amp;amp; \u00c9valuation&lt;\/strong&gt; : Capacit\u00e9 \u00e0 diagnostiquer une r\u00e9ponse incorrecte (probl\u00e8me de mod\u00e8le, de &lt;em&gt;retrieval&lt;\/em&gt; ou de donn\u00e9es) et app\u00e9tence pour l&#39;observabilit\u00e9 applicative (SQL \/ BigQuery \/ MLflow).&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Langues &lt;\/strong&gt;: Fran\u00e7ais courant obligatoire &amp;amp; anglais professionnel courant (environnement international).&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Les plus :&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Connaissance technique approfondie des protocoles A2A (Agent-to-Agent) et MCP.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Exp\u00e9rience de traitement multimodal de documents ou dans des \u00e9cosyst\u00e8mes SIRH (ex: Workday).&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Compr\u00e9hension technique des enjeux de s\u00e9curit\u00e9 (RBAC, ACLs, RGPD) appliqu\u00e9s aux LLMs.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Connaissance des architectures microservices et conception d&#39;APIs.&lt;br&gt;&lt;br&gt;&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;\ud83c\udf81 CE QUE NOUS PROPOSONS&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;L&#39;opportunit\u00e9 de d\u00e9velopper un produit d&#39;IA agentique de pointe avec un impact direct sur le quotidien de 100 000 collaborateurs.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Un environnement technologique premium (Stack Google Cloud \/ Vertex AI \/ Databricks).&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Une politique de t\u00e9l\u00e9travail flexible (2 jours par semaine en remote, le reste dans nos bureaux \u00e0 Paris - Canal de l\u2019Ourcq).&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Une culture du &lt;em&gt;delivery&lt;\/em&gt; ax\u00e9e sur l&#39;autonomie, l&#39;intelligence collective et la mont\u00e9e en comp\u00e9tences (accompagnement par un Lead, certifications, formations).&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Des avantages attractifs (primes mensuelles\/trimestrielles, actionnariat salari\u00e9).&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Une ambiance r\u00e9solument tourn\u00e9e vers le sport (nombreuses corpos, tests produits, pauses d\u00e9jeuner sportives ou non, \u2026)&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;&lt;div class=&quot;content-conclusion&quot;&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;DECATHLON DIGITAL&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Imaginez si la technologie nous permettait de repousser les fronti\u00e8res et d&#39;offrir des exp\u00e9riences sportives in\u00e9dites. C&#39;est pr\u00e9cis\u00e9ment notre ambition chez Decathlon Digital ! Nous sommes une \u00e9quipe de plus de 5 000 experts en ing\u00e9nierie logicielle, gestion de produits, donn\u00e9es, cloud et cybers\u00e9curit\u00e9, r\u00e9partis \u00e0 Paris, Lille et Amsterdam. Ensemble, nous cr\u00e9ons la plus vaste plateforme sportive num\u00e9rique, en exploitant les innovations technologiques pour optimiser la cha\u00eene de valeur, concevoir des exp\u00e9riences connect\u00e9es et donner une seconde vie \u00e0 nos produits.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Changeons la donne pour de bon.&lt;\/strong&gt; Notre passion du sport nous guide et nous voulons qu\u2019elle perdure. C\u2019est pourquoi nous nous engageons \u00e0 b\u00e2tir un mod\u00e8le technologique plus durable, en r\u00e9duisant notre impact direct sur l&#39;environnement, et en cr\u00e9ant un espace s\u00fbr et inclusif pour apprendre et nous \u00e9panouir ensemble. Pour mener \u00e0 bien cette mission, nous recherchons des \u00e9tudiants motiv\u00e9s et pr\u00eats \u00e0 mettre leur \u00e9nergie au service d\u2019une cause qui a du sens&nbsp;\u00bb<\/em> <\/p><p>HI, Humanit\u00e9 &amp; Inclusion est une organisation de solidarit\u00e9 internationale ind\u00e9pendante et impartiale, qui intervient dans les situations de pauvret\u00e9 et d\u2019exclusion, de conflits et de catastrophes. \u0152uvrant aux c\u00f4t\u00e9s des personnes handicap\u00e9es et des populations vuln\u00e9rables, elle agit et t\u00e9moigne, pour r\u00e9pondre \u00e0 leurs besoins essentiels, pour am\u00e9liorer leurs conditions de vie et promouvoir le respect de leur dignit\u00e9 et de leurs droits fondamentaux.<\/p><p>Chez Handicap International, nous croyons fermement en l'importance de l'inclusion et de la diversit\u00e9 au sein de notre structure. C'est pourquoi nous sommes engag\u00e9s dans une politique handicap afin de favoriser l'accueil et l'int\u00e9gration de personnes en situation de handicap.&nbsp;&nbsp;<\/p><p>Merci d\u2019indiquer si vous avez besoin d\u2019un am\u00e9nagement particulier, y compris pour participer aux 1ers entretiens.&nbsp;<\/p><p>&nbsp;<\/p><p>Pour plus d\u2019information sur l\u2019association : <a href=\"http:\/\/www.hi.org\/\" rel=\"nofollow noreferrer noopener\" class=\"external\">www.hi.org<\/a><\/p><p>&nbsp;<\/p><p><strong>OBJECTIFS DU STAGE : <\/strong><\/p><p> <\/p><p>Le stage se fera au sein du service Sensibilisation - Communication de Handicap International, au si\u00e8ge de Lyon, dans le cadre des missions quotidiennes du service avec un large volet d\u00e9di\u00e9 \u00e0 l\u2019organisation des d\u00e9ploiements des Pyramides de chaussures. \u00catre un soutien au service Sensibilisation - Communication dans leurs actions de sensibilisation et tout projet.&nbsp;<\/p><p> <\/p><p>Nous vous invitons \u00e0 prendre connaissance des actions de sensibilisation et mobilisation en consultant&nbsp;: <a href=\"https:\/\/www.handicap-international.fr\/fr\/mobilisation\/je-me-mobilise\" rel=\"nofollow noreferrer noopener\" class=\"external\">l\u2019Espace du b\u00e9n\u00e9volat et de la sensibilisation pour Handicap International<\/a>.<\/p><p> <\/p><p>La mission se d\u00e9roulera du 11 janvier au 10 juillet 2027 (6 mois).<\/p><p> <\/p><p>Les Pyramides de chaussures c\u2019est le temps fort de sensibilisation et de mobilisation citoyenne pour Handicap International. Depuis plus de 30 ans, tous les citoyens, scolaires, salari\u00e9s d\u2019entreprises, sympathisants de Handicap International ou encore politiques sont invit\u00e9s \u00e0 venir :<\/p><p>-&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; Lancer leurs chaussures pour t\u00e9moigner de leur soutien aux causes port\u00e9es par Handicap International, la chaussure symbole de l\u2019engagement citoyen pour prot\u00e9ger les civils ;<\/p><p>-&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; S\u2019informer \u00e0 travers une exposition interactive, ludique et p\u00e9dagogique sur Handicap International, ses champs d\u2019intervention et ses combats ;<\/p><p>-&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; Rencontrer et \u00e9changer avec nos experts terrain<\/p><p><\/p><p>Depuis 2024 Handicap International a d\u00e9velopp\u00e9 des Pyramides de chaussures dites \u00ab&nbsp;mobiles&nbsp;\u00bb. Le but&nbsp;? \u00catre pr\u00e9sent toute l\u2019ann\u00e9e partout en France. Gr\u00e2ce \u00e0 ce dispositif nous pouvons aller au plus proche de nos diff\u00e9rentes cibles (scolaire, sympathisants, grand public, \u00e9lus, m\u00e9dias) et leur proposer un temps de sensibilisation complet sur nos missions dans le monde. Pour en savoir plus sur les Pyramides&nbsp;: <a href=\"https:\/\/www.handicap-international.fr\/fr\/pyramides-de-chaussures\" rel=\"nofollow noreferrer noopener\" class=\"external\">https:\/\/www.handicap-international.fr\/fr\/pyramides-de-chaussures<\/a> <\/p><p> <\/p><p>Le stage sera orient\u00e9 autour de trois volets&nbsp; <\/p><p>-&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; Appui \u00e0 la prospection (recherche de structures h\u00f4tes ou de partenaires int\u00e9ress\u00e9s par des visites guid\u00e9es)<\/p><p>-&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; Appui \u00e9v\u00e9nementiel et logistique pour la pr\u00e9paration et le d\u00e9roulement des d\u00e9ploiements.<\/p><p>-&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; Animation aupr\u00e8s du public (visites guid\u00e9es, actions de sensibilisation, \u00e9changes lors d\u2019\u00e9v\u00e8nements).<\/p><p> <\/p><p>Le stage implique des d\u00e9placements r\u00e9guliers (environ deux par mois) dans le cadre des animations et \u00e9v\u00e8nements ext\u00e9rieurs. Ces missions sont l\u2019occasion de belles rencontres et d\u2019\u00e9changes enrichissants avec des publics vari\u00e9s. <\/p><p>Le stage combine la prospection de nouveaux lieux de d\u00e9ploiement, l'appui \u00e0 la coordination \u00e9v\u00e9nementielle et logistique et l'animation aupr\u00e8s de publics vari\u00e9s. Une bonne connaissance des actions, des valeurs et des prises de position de Handicap International est n\u00e9cessaire pour adapter les messages de sensibilisation au contexte g\u00e9opolitique.<\/p><p> <\/p><p><strong>Activit\u00e9 1 :<\/strong> Participer \u00e0 la pr\u00e9paration et au d\u00e9ploiement des Pyramides de chaussures 2027<\/p><p>-&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; Prospection : identifier et contacter des villes, structures et partenaires susceptibles d'accueillir une Pyramide ; contribuer au suivi des contacts et des opportunit\u00e9s.<\/p><p>-&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; Participation aux \u00e9v\u00e9nements en France : appui \u00e0 la coordination sur place, installation et d\u00e9montage, animation de visites guid\u00e9es, prises de parole et \u00e9changes avec les publics.<\/p><p>-&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp; IonQ is making quantum platforms more accessible and impactful than ever before. &amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;&lt;\/div&gt;&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Location:&lt;\/strong&gt; This role is based onsite in Geneva, Switzerland.&lt;br&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Travel:&lt;\/strong&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;strong&gt;&lt;br&gt;Job ID:&lt;\/strong&gt; 1893&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;ID Quantique (IDQ), part of IonQ, is a global leader in quantum-safe communications. We provide solutions to protect governments, telecommunication infrastructures, and banking &amp;amp; financial institutions from the \u201charvest-now, decrypt-later\u201d threat, delivering both terrestrial and space-based quantum-safe networks in live operation globally.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;The Role:&amp;nbsp;&lt;br&gt;&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;We are looking for a Senior Manager reporting to the Senior Manager, Hardware, to lead the people and the execution of our cryptographic engineering team. This team builds post-quantum cryptography (PQC) hardware acceleration for our quantum-safe product portfolio, targeting hardware security module (HSM) and network-appliance applications. This is a people-leadership and delivery role: you will manage and develop a team of 8+ highly specialised engineers, own programme execution, and partner closely with the programme\u2019s senior technical leadership, who own the architecture and technical direction. It is an opportunity to lead exceptional people on a strategic security product line at one of the few companies where quantum-safe security is the core business.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Responsibilities&lt;\/strong&gt;:&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;You will manage engineers spanning applied cryptography, RTL and FPGA design, firmware and protocols, verification, QA and security certification: recruiting and onboarding, coaching and career development, objective setting, performance management and retention, building a high-performing and collaborative engineering culture. You will own execution of the programme: planning and milestones, dependency and risk management, resource allocation, budget ownership\/management, and clear reporting to executive stakeholders. You will put in place the engineering processes the team runs on (development workflow, reviews, tooling, lab operations), remove blockers, and coordinate with talent acquisition, HR, product management, certification bodies, IP vendors and customers. You will work hand in hand with the programme\u2019s senior technical leaders, giving them the room to own technical direction while you make the organisation around them work.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Lead, recruit, develop and retain a team of highly specialised engineers across cryptography, hardware, software, verification, QA and security disciplines&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Own programme execution end to end: planning, risks, budget ownership\/management, processes and executive reporting, in close partnership with the senior technical leadership&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Requirements:&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;We are looking for a candidate with a Master\u2019s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science or a related field (or equivalent) and at least ten years in the development of complex hardware, embedded or security products, including five or more years of direct people management of engineering teams that shipped certified products. You have enough technical depth in digital hardware, embedded software or security engineering to earn the respect of deep specialists, to follow their trade-offs and to ask the right questions; exposure to cryptography or security products is a strong advantage.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;You hire well and have grown senior specialists; you give honest feedback, delegate real ownership, and build teams people want to stay in. You run execution with rigour (planning, risk, reporting) without drowning engineers in process, and you communicate crisply with executives, partners and customers. Fluency in English is required; French or German is an advantage.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Proven engineering people manager who has built and led specialist teams to shipped hardware or security products&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Execution owner with the technical credibility to lead deep experts, while leaving technical direction to the programme\u2019s senior technical leadership&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Preferred Qualifications:&lt;br&gt;&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;You lead through trust, clarity and service to the team rather than hierarchy. Your primary purpose will be to lead medical excellence initiatives across the Medical Affairs organization, such as scientific communications, field medical, training and other medical excellence priorities as the business evolves. This role requires effective collaboration with Medical Directors, cross-functional colleagues and external experts to ensure scientifically rigorous, consistent and compliant communications and practices. The ideal candidate combines deep expertise in scientific\/medical communications with strong project management experience and stakeholder management skills, and thrives on delivering priorities in a fast-paced, hands-on environment.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;h3&gt;&lt;strong&gt;&lt;u&gt;Responsibilities&lt;\/u&gt;&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/h3&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Support the development of scientific communication plans from an international perspective (i.e., core scientific narratives, key messages and Q&amp;amp;A documents), in close collaboration with Medical Directors and cross-functional brand teams&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Develop high-quality scientific and medical education content for congresses, symposia, advisory boards, internal training and other settings, ensuring alignment with the medical strategy&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Partner with Legal, Regulatory and Medical reviewers to ensure all scientific and medical communications are accurate, balanced and compliant, in line with the Medical, Legal and Regulatory (MLR) review process&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Support the design and delivery of onboarding, training and continuous learning programs for Medical Affairs, including building scientific and therapeutic area capability across the organization&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Manage relationships with medical communications agencies, medical writers and other vendors to ensure high-quality, on-time, on-budget deliverables&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Support the review, evaluation and compliant administration of independent medical education grants, scientific sponsorships and related third-party contracting, partnering with Legal, Compliance and Finance to ensure appropriate governance and documentation&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Contribute to the development of standards, processes, tools and best practices that elevate medical excellence across areas such as Field Medical, insights generation &amp;amp; analysis, key performance indicators, training and other Medical Affairs priorities as business needs evolve&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;h3&gt;&lt;strong&gt;&lt;u&gt;Where You\u2019ll Work&amp;nbsp; &lt;\/u&gt;&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/h3&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;This is an office role and requires in-office collaboration 2-3 days per week in our Zug office&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;No relocation is offered&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Travel (approximately 10-20%) may be required to support scientific congresses, advisory boards, training sessions and internal meetings&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;h3&gt;&lt;strong&gt;&lt;u&gt;Who You Are&lt;\/u&gt;&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/h3&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Bachelor&#39;s degree in life sciences, pharmacy, medicine, or a related scientific discipline is required; an advanced degree (PhD, PharmD, MD, or MSc) is strongly preferred&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;7+ years of Medical Affairs experience in the biotech\/pharmaceutical industry, in one or more of the following areas: scientific\/medical communications, field medical, medical training, or related medical excellence functions&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Strong scientific writing and editing skills, with the ability to translate complex clinical and scientific data into clear, accurate, audience-appropriate materials&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Demonstrated experience developing scientific platforms, key messages, and training or capability-building programs in partnership with cross-functional medical and clinical teams&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Experience managing external vendors\/agencies and navigating MLR review processes; familiarity with grants, sponsorships, or contracting processes is an advantage&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Versatile and adaptable, able to shift between medical excellence priorities as business needs evolve&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Excellent project management and stakeholder management skills; experience in rare disease is an advantage&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Fluent in English; additional language skills are an advantage&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;&lt;u&gt;Rewarding Those Who Make the Mission Possible&lt;\/u&gt;&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;We have high expectations for our team members. This is an individual contributor role with no direct reports: BridgeBio&#39;s operating model delivers International IT work through external vendors and consultants, and this role provides both the strategic direction and the hands-on technical expertise needed to design, direct, and validate that work. You report to the Executive Director, IT Enterprise Applications in the US, and partner closely with International business leaders and US-based IT counterparts.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;You will own the International application and technology roadmap and business relationship, for Commercial and Medical Affairs systems including Veeva CRM, Databricks, and Analytics, while ensuring alignment with enterprise owned platforms managed by US teams. For core enterprise systems such as SAP S\/4HANA, Coupa, Malbek CLM, and Workday HRIS, you will act as the International liaison, ensuring local business needs, regulatory requirements, and market nuances are represented in both strategy and system design. You will direct and technically oversee the consultants and partners who execute this work.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;h3&gt;&lt;strong&gt;&lt;u&gt;Responsibilities&lt;\/u&gt;&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/h3&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Serve as the primary strategic IT partner to International business opportunities through data, automation, AI, and enterprise technologies&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Own end-to-end demand management, prioritization, and delivery of International IT initiatives, including We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.<\/p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><\/p><h3>The Role<\/h3><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">We are seeking a detail-oriented Mechanical Design Engineer to join our engineering team in Lausanne. In this role, you will lead the physical product design of hardware assemblies, mechanical housings, custom structures, and precision mechanisms, guiding products through CAD design, drafting, prototype verification, and industrialisation.<\/p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">From day one, you will own the transition of concepts into production-ready physical hardware. You will maintain strict product data management standards, apply geometric dimensioning and tolerancing, run thermal and stress analyses, work with suppliers across various manufacturing processes, and perform hands-on prototype assembly and testing.<\/p><h3>What You Will Do<\/h3><ul style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>CAD Design &amp; Drafting:<\/strong> Create clean, fully constrained CAD models, multi-part assembly layouts, and detailed engineering drawings following formal geometric dimensioning and tolerancing standards.<\/p><\/li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Product Data &amp; Configuration Management:<\/strong> Manage engineering change requests, update bill of materials data, maintain material libraries, and enforce configuration controls in digital product data systems.<\/p><\/li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Prototype Assembly &amp; Verification:<\/strong> Build physical prototypes, test assembly sequences, verify fit and tolerance stack-ups, and establish unit build procedures.<\/p><\/li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Environmental &amp; Stress Analysis:<\/strong> Perform structural, thermal, vibration, and mechanical shock simulations to ensure hardware survives harsh operational environments.<\/p><\/li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Manufacturing &amp; Supplier Integration:<\/strong> Work closely with suppliers to optimize designs for production methods such as CNC machining, stamping, pressing, forging, casting, and injection molding.<\/p><\/li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Cross-Functional Interface Management:<\/strong> Collaborate with electronics, simulation, testing, and systems engineering teams to define physical interface control documents, packaging requirements, and technical datasheets.<\/p><\/li><\/ul><h3>What We Are Looking For<\/h3><ul style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>Background:<\/strong> Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a related field.<\/p><\/li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"><strong>CAD &amp; We launch new banks, transform existing ones, and help our clients navigate complex change. As consultants, we work on the front-end business design all the way through to technology implementation.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;We are the largest Financial Services focused consultancy in the world, serving everyone from global banks to emerging FinTechs, from strategy through digital transformation, design, business consulting, data and analytics, cyber, cloud, technology architecture, and engineering.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Capco is a young and growing firm. account ownership: retention, expansion and net new MRR across a named set of top-tier accounts; identifying risk early, preventing churn and downgrades; pipeline creation and forecasting.<\/span><\/p><\/li><li><p style=\"text-align:justify;\"><span style=\"color:#000000\">Voice of the customer: running trainings and enablement for large advertisers and partner teams, feeding client insight back to product and commercial, and turning your strongest accounts into webinars, success stories and references.<\/span><\/p><\/li><li><p style=\"text-align:justify;\"><span style=\"color:#000000\">Raising the bar: contributing to how we manage the strategic segment, account plans, risk signals, expansion playbooks, and Customer Success processes.<\/span><\/p><\/li><\/ul><p style=\"min-height: 1.7em;\"><\/p><h4><strong><span style=\"color:#000000\">What you bring:<\/span><\/strong><\/h4><ul><li><p><span style=\"color:#000000\">You have 3+ years' experience in Customer Success, Account Management, Partnership Management, or a similar client-facing commercial role, with a track record on large or complex accounts. That\u2019s why it\u2019s our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. We\u2019re shaping the future of a $10T industry with solutions powered by innovative technology and exceptional people. Today, companies of all sizes\u2014from emerging brands to Fortune 500s\u2014use Flexport technology to move more than $19B of merchandise across 112 countries a year.&amp;nbsp;&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us.&lt;\/p&gt;&lt;\/div&gt;&lt;h1&gt;Staff Software Engineer: Applied AI&lt;\/h1&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;Every day, thousands of shipments cross borders, change hands, and hit unexpected problems. For decades, fixing those problems meant phone calls, emails, and humans heroically firefighting. We think that&#39;s about to change completely.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;We&#39;ve been building AI agents that spot trouble before it happens, reroute shipments, and keep goods moving\u2014with our team of experts in the loop where it counts. The early results have been jaw-dropping. We&#39;re now going all in on a future where supply chains run themselves, and we&#39;re looking for the people who want to build that future with us.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;This isn&#39;t a role where you join a team and pick up tickets. You&#39;ll find the highest-leverage problems, design the solutions, and ship them to operators moving freight across 112 countries. If that sounds like your idea of a good time, read on.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;h2&gt;What You&#39;ll Do&lt;\/h2&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;You&#39;ll build the cutting-edge agents and AI-powered applications that make Flexport&#39;s operations smarter, faster, and increasingly autonomous. That means:&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Designing and shipping &lt;strong&gt;end-to-end AI agents&lt;\/strong&gt; that handle real logistics work\u2014customs compliance, document processing, exception management, and more&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Crossing organizational boundaries&lt;\/strong&gt; to understand problems deeply, align stakeholders, and get things done without waiting for permission&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Moving fast from idea to production, treating every deployment as a learning opportunity&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Working directly with operators, domain experts, and leadership to turn ambiguous problems into shipped solutions&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;h2&gt;You Should Have&lt;\/h2&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;10+ years of software engineering experience&lt;\/strong&gt;; you&#39;ve built with LLMs extensively \u2014 whether in production, side projects, or just because you couldn&#39;t stop yourself&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Strong product instincts&lt;\/strong&gt;: you can identify what&#39;s worth building, not just execute on a spec&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;LLM fluency&lt;\/strong&gt;: agent patterns, RAG, prompt engineering, tool use, evaluation. You know what works in production and what looks good in demos&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Full-stack capability&lt;\/strong&gt; in TypeScript and Next.js\u2014you can own a feature end to end&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;An entrepreneurial drive&lt;\/strong&gt;: you thrive in ambiguity, move fast, and don&#39;t wait to be told what to do&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Excellent communication&lt;\/strong&gt;: you can work across teams and disciplines to get alignment and unblock yourself&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;An audacious appetite for impact&lt;\/strong&gt;: you&#39;re not here to maintain\u2014you&#39;re here to change how global trade works&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;h2&gt;Nice to Have&lt;\/h2&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Experience with workflow orchestration (Temporal, etc.)&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;Experience building internal tools or operator-facing applications&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;h2&gt;How We Work&lt;\/h2&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;We come to the office 3 times a week to hang out, whiteboard, and ship together&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;We have the latest hardware and software\u2014including frontier AI models on day one&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;We&#39;re agile, but not dogmatic. Teams decide how they work best&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Stack&lt;\/strong&gt;: Next.js, TypeScript, Postgres, Snowflake. You\u2019ll help the team grow, set its technical direction and build on work already underway across data foundations and production machine learning.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;The role spans two connected disciplines. You\u2019ll bring deep experience in either Data Engineering or Machine Learning Engineering, and enough breadth to set direction across the other.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;You\u2019ll partner with Product, Engineering, Analytics and business stakeholders to set priorities and connect the team\u2019s work to outcomes across Catawiki.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;h3&gt;&lt;strong&gt;What you&#39;ll do&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/h3&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;You\u2019ll lead the team through platform modernisation and product-facing ML work. Current priorities include modernising the infrastructure for serving production models, introducing a feature store to improve feature management and consistency across model training and serving, and strengthening observability and cost controls. You\u2019ll help set priorities and raise the reliability and impact of this work.&lt;\/p&gt;\n&lt;ul&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Lead and develop the team:&lt;\/strong&gt; Set direction, coach experienced specialists and create clear ownership across Data Engineering and Machine Learning.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Build dependable data foundations:&lt;\/strong&gt; Improve the pipelines, integrations and infrastructure the wider Data team relies on for analysis, reporting and machine learning.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Strengthen production ML:&lt;\/strong&gt; Improve deployment, monitoring and operational follow-through for production models, so teams can run them reliably and resolve issues effectively.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Advance marketplace models:&lt;\/strong&gt; Help teams improve recommendation, cancellation and bidder-risk use cases, connecting model performance to meaningful product outcomes.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Set direction and priorities:&lt;\/strong&gt; Work with Product, Engineering, Analytics and business partners to choose high-value problems and balance delivery, reliability and long-term platform health.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;li&gt;&lt;strong&gt;Shape the technology strategy:&lt;\/strong&gt; Reporting to the SVP Engineering, you\u2019ll join the Engineering Management team and help shape the direction of the Technology department.&lt;\/li&gt;\n&lt;\/ul&gt;\n&lt;h3&gt;&lt;strong&gt;What you&#39;ll bring&lt;\/strong&gt;&lt;\/h3&gt;\n&lt;p&gt;You combine strong technical judgement with experienced people leadership.
